rationale: The advisory designates two distinct front-company networks giving sanctioned/designated interests a clean commercial face (p.1 SAN004 doctrine): (1) over a dozen Mexican operating businesses across real estate, entertainment, fuel retail, private security and currency exchange, each tied by OFAC to a single Sinaloa Cartel-linked individual, e.g. p.4 'BAJA FIXER GROUP...(Linked To: MORENO GOMEZ SANTELICES, Marco Antonio)'; (2) an identically-branded 'Cavalier Dynamics' entity incorporated separately in Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey (p.4) plus a Hong Kong trading company under three aliases (p.5), both tied to Iran's Kavoshcom/Ministry of Defense network (p.3, p.6), used to procure for the sanctioned Iranian military-industrial complex.
